RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 50

An all-male panel can signal institutional blind spots or in-group bias, particularly when your administrative qualifications appear stronger on paper. However, panel composition alone does not prove sex discrimination, as selections also hinge on interview scoring, references, and subjective fit.

Raising the panel's gender makeup immediately risks creating defensiveness before you receive documentation. Instead, first follow up firmly on your requested written explanation. Once you have their official scoring and justification, you can evaluate whether merit-based criteria were disregarded. If your jurisdiction or public-sector regulations mandate gender-balanced hiring panels, or if the written justification reveals arbitrary standards, you can raise the procedural composition through your union, legal counsel, or an oversight board.
